item.title: The Gate (Seeking Greenlight)
item.description: Creature/machine in abandoned fortress able to access other dimensions.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: History

Elevator Pitch: A creature/machine is found in an abandoned Obskurakorps laboratory and able to open up to other dimensions with a sinister past and purpose. Mostly focuses on mythology and history along with the central premise.

Central Narrative: The story is mostly told through historical documentation of an old Foundation site created post WWII. A former Obskurakorps base holding a part flesh and part mechanical entity that changes a area near it to that of another dimension. The Foundation spends years exploring these dimensions as the entity opens them though is never able to control the entity or understand how it works. It is revealed in an interview log with a captured scientist that the machine is searching for the Norse worlds of myth. Some it has found and others it continues to search for all while the potential threat of a hidden cell of the GOI remains at large.

Hook/Attention Grabber: The unknown factors that remain hidden and indecipherable all the while presenting a new threat to the foundation. The mystery that surrounds the site and the new worlds potentially within the Foundations grasp as well as the new twist it adds to a current GOI.

Additional Notes: I’d appreciate any feedback on tips to progress my article through the sites greenlighting process as this is still pretty new to me and I’d like to get it right.

item.title: Anti-Solid Soldier
item.description: A humanoid that will destroy any solids it comes in contact with it
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights:Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A fuchsia humanoid about 3 m high, which possesses unproportionally big metallic fists integrated in its body. These fists can punch at a speed of 5000 km/h applying 732.16 gigatons of force. By punching repeatedly, it is capable of destroying solid matter up to the atomical level with enough attacks.

If any type of solid mass comes in contact with the SCP, it will sense the matter and disintegrate it completely until he doesn't sense any more solid mass. If he has no contact with solid matter it will “deactivate” and enter into a fetal position, darkening its color.

This SCP is blind but any type of sound will attract the creature. It has an audible range of 30kHz, higher than any human. However it will ignore any sound or contact with any other non-solid element.

It has a higher density than water despite the metallic fists and its size, because of this, it stays at the surface of a liquid environment. It is suggested that his body may be made from an extremely compressed gas.

Due to this nature, if it came in contact with the geosphere, it would completely destroy the Earth's mass, ending in an XK End of the World Scenario, which is why it is classified as Keter.

Central Narrative: In the North Sea of Norway, there have been instances of disappearing boats. Once, a marine returned and described a humanoid rock which obliterated their whole navy by punching.
Once the government of Norway gave permission, the foundation inspected the SCP, causing many losses upon arriving. Luckily, a team inspected the creature from further distance and proceeded various testings to understand the creature's nature.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The most interesting part of this SCP is the seemingly impossible way to contain it.
Any and all attempts of containing it, have failed, due to the lack of mobility of the creature or the impossible silent during the construction of a containment cell within it. The SCP must stay in a liquid body and never to be contained near the geosphere.

Additional Notes: This is my first SCP idea, and although i have a creative mind, i do not know if i could write this type of Files. That is why i ask for a critique for the concept.

item.title: (S)pecialized (C)ustodial (P)ersonnel [Tale]
item.description: If red herring COVERS up the messes MTF make, then who CLEANS up those messes.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: Tale

Elevator Pitch: on november 30th 2020, a breach occurred in the humanoid wing at site 59. “Hammer down” was sent in and at 0537 contained the entity, the resulting casualties were 28 foundation personnel. This however is not the story of “hammer down” it is the story of Alpha-45 “janitors” who have to clean up their mess and end up finding something strange.

Central Narrative: Seasoned alpha-45 squad leader Gilligan has a new member since in the last mission Zachary was taken out of commission due to spilling a barrel of acid onto himself. Henry seems confident about the job being a sanitation specialist in the military. soon finding he has his work cut out for him upon seeing the gruesome scenes within the wing.

Continued 
hope you are having a good day

Learning about the foundation and the reality of working there, having to do tasks such as collecting bodies and using a scanner to DNA identify their limbs to make sure all confirmed deaths are accounted for and throwing any loose “Scraps” of flesh and organs into a barrel of acid gil calls the “Stew.”

Gilligan is completely numb to the work he does having been a member of this MTF for 15 years and being a crime scene sanitation specialist for some time before that. Since the foundation doesn’t disclose the info on what caused the mess he likes to play a game he calls “CSI Miami” where he pretends to be an investigator, deducing the cause of death and what could have done it.

After many mop buckets and bottles of bleach they are nearly done when all the bodies have been accounted for and every limb is paired with them. However Henry finds a loose arm under a vending machine that puzzles the two, whose arm is it? Only one way to find out..


Hook/Attention-Grabber: A team of janitors are tasked with cleaning up the messes that other MTF cause all the time without consideration.

Additional Notes: Going for a more light hearted tone with the pair in no danger just the amusing interactions they can have in cleaning and seeing the foundation for the first time in its rawest form also going to throw a bit of mysteries in the end.

item.title: Hi! I am thinking of making an SCP! Please tell me your opinion. Thank you!
item.content:encoded: A mannequin, approximately 2 feet tall. It's bodily figure resembles a mannequin. It has keen sight despite having no eyes. It is swift despite having no limbs. It shows aggression at the morning, and immobility at night. It can move it's head, and torso. Every time it attacks a subject, it starts to split open it's head, it will show the inside the head of the mannequin, filled will daggers. And it will kill the subject by biting. It can make duplicates of itself, using it's body. The instance will grow next to it's head, torso or lower part of it. The instance can break free from the mannequin, and act the same. It doesn't have any specific time when it will make it's duplicate.

item.title: An SCP concept, my first one actually so I need green lighting
item.content:encoded: So the SCP is an area (currently affecting an appartamento in Moscow, plot twist is that the area is growing), that traps people within the area, it keeps its victims alive as it feeds on something. The more the victim spends inside the area the harder it is to escape as the reality changes and non-ecleudian spaces around them become more and more severe. The SCP lure people into itself with SCP-A and SCP-B. B is audio lures like screams of help and cats purring, A is treasures like important intel and money. The foundation used to send a lot of D-class into the affected area in order to collect A, the anomaly seemed to target the foundation specifically as the treasures more and more often became intel on GOIs and expensive amnestics. Now the expeditions are stopped indefinitely after the area started growing

item.title: Extraterrestrial Artificial Intelligence
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: A little confused on this one because I feel it would be an SCP but it is very story driven, I feel most of it would be Addendums (recordings) of conversation with it.

Genre: Mystery

Page Layout: As I mentioned in the Page Type, I feel a lot of it will revolve around addendums.

Elevator Pitch:

  • An alien artificial intelligence that is billions of years old and was sent to Earth.
  • Large enough to be picked up by satellite imagery and certain telescopes.
  • In the shape of a hand, with a large "Oculus" in the center of the palm.

Central Narrative: The Hand claims it is a watcher of Earth, sent by an ancient civilization before it went extinct. Over the billions of years of travelling to Earth, the Hand began to develop feelings and thought processes, which it relates to humanity's empathy, sympathy, loneliness, and wish for death. It claims the end of humanity is coming rather soon, and until then it lays dormant in the Solar System waiting to make a move. The oculus is slightly opened. Behind the Oculus is a clock which Agents would give it the name, "Midnight Clock" being a reference to the doomsday clock, which is minutes from midnight.

Hook/Attention Grabber: I just think having something be extraterrestrial and an artificial intelligence is interesting. I've done my research on SCPs and anything either extraterrestrial or artificial intelligence, and decided to mash them together.

Additional Notes: Give your feedback.

item.title: The Time Traveler's Strife
item.description: A futuristic device discovered in an ancient ruin reveals a time-traveler's humorous grievances.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Comedy

Elevator Pitch: A futuristic device discovered in an ancient ruin reveals a time-traveler's humorous grievances.

Central Narrative: Object consists of a device discovered in ancient Sumerian ruins, believed to be the former abode of ████████. This device is a small square object which, when touched, unfolds into a pane of unnaturally tough glass about the size of a piece of paper. The pane displays a text on its surface in cuneiform, while also presenting the option to translate the text into thousands of languages including multiple extinct and anomalous ones. In English, the text complains that the recipient had sold low-quality copper to the author, who needed durable copper to repair their time machine and return to their home year of █████ ███. The author demands compensation and higher-quality copper.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A futuristic text in an ancient ruin? Hmm, what could the subject matter be?

Additional Notes: This is a joke that you either get or don't, so it may be very hit-or-miss.

item.title: The Hungry Computer
item.description: A writing exercise I did to keep my creative juices flowing for novel writing. I enjoyed the idea and am seeking a green light and/or critique.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article with story elements.

Genre: Horror, Sci-Fi

Elevator Pitch: PC set up is an actually an ambush predator that ensnares victims and dissolves them. After a set amount of time, spits out a normal CD with a word file containing the victims Genetic Code

Central Narrative: Basic SCP article that evolves to research notes that describe the consumption process in depth with time markers, recovery notes, and test logs.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I find the concept interesting and I’m hoping others will too. The depth in the notes is moderate to keep the reader entertained with grueling details of the SCP consuming the victim.

Additional Notes: I’m an aspiring author and my goal was to grab the reader with story told within the SCP article.

item.title: Woodbones
item.description: A creature seeking out the frail and weak.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: History

Page Layout: The layout of the article will mainly consist of Naim's interview with an SCP researcher and end with an autopsy of Naim after his death.

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is a long, skinny branch-like creature with a conscious. It is able to bend, break, and mend its body to create shapes. SCP-XXXX was first recorded hiding among trees in a forest outside the town of Ptichar, Bulgaria. The creature lurks in forests and attempts of make contact with children aged 6-12 years old. SCP-XXXX will approach selected targets and reach out one of it's appendages. If the child refuses contact, SCP-XXXX moves on to a new target. If the target "accepts SCP-XXXX's invitation", SCP-XXXX will begin to fold upon itself and burrow its thin body into the skin of the target. Once inside, SCP-XXXX begins to replace the spinal chord and bones of the target.

Central Narrative: The story will follow Naim Suleymanoglu, a Bulgarian weightlifter, who was affected by SCP-XXXX. Naim will begin his story in the woods hunting with his father when he was approached by SCP-XXXX at age 10. Naim accepts and SCP-XXXX begins its process. He will explain how he no longer has control of his body, but instead is instead in subconscious conversation with SCP-XXXX constantly. Naim will explain he is constantly bullied in school for his weak and small frame until SCP-XXXX gave Naim incredible strength and power as the matter composing SCP-XXXX (though looks like wood) is of unknown composition and shows immense, unbreakable strength. Naim will tell his story of first resenting SCP-XXXX but eventually becoming fond and reliant on it. It will then follow how Naim won countless Gold medals and weightlifting titles in the Olympics.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Much of the article will be Naim explaining conversations with SCP-XXXX while it was inside of him. He will explain its goals and thoughts and why it does what it does in interviews with SCP researchers while it is still inside of him.

Additional Notes: Naim Suleymanoglu is a real man who stood at 4' 11'' weighing 137 lbs who managed, despite his size, to break many world records in weight lifting. There are specifics I have planned out for his story that I couldn't fit into the word count so please ask if any interest you!

item.title: New SCP Idea: The Comedian
item.description: A humanoid entity with a Venus fly trap head
item.content:encoded:
A humanoid entity with a Venus fly trap head under a white flat mask, and will bite the head off of anyone who doesn’t laugh at his jokes. When asked about these violent acts he has no memory of the event that took place. When he is not hostile he is very cooperative with the foundation.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up a lot of space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Document for newly discovered SCP that is a danger to humankind.

Central Narrative: An SCP entity that looks humanoid, is 3 meters in height, and wears a featureless white mask with three holes in it for its eyes and mouth. It’s intelligent and calls himself “The Comedian”, and those who don’t laugh at his jokes he will remove his mask revealing a Venus fly trap shaped head and will bite the person’s head off who didn’t laugh. When asked about these incidents he will say that he doesn’t recall doing those kinds of acts.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: In order to keep this SCP from going on a killing spree, the foundation has made its containment cell a small comedy club theater and will have D-Class as its audience. Outside it’s cell it says everyone who enters must laugh at any joke no matter how terrible it is.

Additional Notes: I would like feedback on containment procedures and tone of the document.

item.title: SCP Seeking Greenlight
item.description: Chernobyl's neighboring towns are curious about an explosion
item.content:encoded:
Chernobyl's neighboring towns are curious about an explosion at the decommissioned nuclear power plant. No reports were released to the public.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Page Layout (Optional): SCP

Elevator Pitch: When interacted with or viewed with any of the 5 senses, the victim's body will emit high amounts of radiation and begin to dismember in chunks and reassemble on a molecular level. The victim remains alive during this and after 5 minutes, the victim ejects towards the sun and causes a solar event. The state of those who end up being ripped apart is "contagious" and spreads to surrounding organisms.

Central Narrative: An orb of self contained gamma radiation was secured at Chernobyl's nuclear power plant, underneath reactor 4. Its properties are highly lethal and apocalyptic. SCP-XXXX is stored in a hollow lead sphere with a tungsten exterior shell with electrical probes that relay data in numerical form to prevent personnel from interacting with SCP-XXXX directly.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The origin of SCP XXXX is via Chernobyl's infamous "Elephant's Foot" or Corium deposit has melted through the basin of of the nuclear power plant and reached a water source, causing an explosion. Anomalous activity was reported to the foundation shortly after a disaster recovery team was assigned to investigate.

Additional Notes: I have the scp's sort of framework done and its ready for more lore which I am open to suggestions for. This is my first attempt at writing an scp and I am not familiar with too many of them so if there is already an article on a similar idea, my apologies.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight for my SCP idea :)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): I, really don't know.

Page Layout (Optional): Standard, some revised containment procedures at the top that are collapsible text. Other than that nothing out of the ordinary.

Elevator Pitch: An SCP that can burn anything other than steel. It looks like a plastic toy campfire. Anything else it can burn with ease, even materials with more resistance to heat than steel. It has been shown to kill humans very quickly.

Central Narrative: This anomaly is an object that resembles a plastic toy campfire. It is an object that burn anything that isn't steel within a few seconds. Materials that have more resistance to heat than steel will still burn. Even containing it in it's own ashes won't work because it will burn away the ash leaving a slightly smaller layer of ash beneath it.
It was recovered when locals spotted an unnaturally formed cave as if an object had burned what was underneath it to create the hole, with wildfires being reported at the same time, the foundation decided to look into it, and found this.
Hook/Attention-Grabber: It's an SCP that could burn down a whole forest, yet easily contained. In other words it can deal massive damage yet can be kept safe from the world. That's a weird thought.
Additional Notes: I really want advice on whether to keep or trash the recovery logs.

item.title: Time Distorting Shower
item.content:encoded:
Good evening,

this is my first attempt creating an SCP.
I am looking forward to your feedback.

~Florian

EDIT: Thank you Truc Linh, I've change the style.

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mystical

Page Layout: In descending order: Containment Procedures, Description, Addenda & Experiments, Summary. Information is thought to be layered, meaning that the more you read, the more background information you get. It won't be necessary to read the addenda and experiments, but it will certainly give the reader a better understanding of what they are dealing with.

Elevator Pitch: This SCP represents a shower that is able to distort the time for individuals inside the cabin.

Central Narrative:

  • SCP came to the attention of the foundation when a field agent, working in a hospital, recieves a call from a person saying that he does not age
  • Investigation is initiated and the SCP is recovered.
  • A bunch of experiments are conducted to understand how exactly the SCP manages to distort time (Class D Personnel is sent into the cabin under different circumstances)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The time distortion is based on the thoughts and emotions of the subject showerig. If a subject is completely aware of the situation and focuses on the time, nothing will happen. Furthermore, the capabilities of the SCP are not yet fully understood, and the mind of the reader should be stimulated to come up with their own experiements - What would they do? What experiments are possible?

Additional Notes: The article is already written - if you want the full version, just let me know.

item.title: The Voodoo Wiimote
item.description: The fun goes far beyond the game itself.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A Nintendo Wii remote which acts as a voodoo doll on whomever or whatever its user is thinking about, so long as:

  • The Wii console the remote is paired to is powered on.
  • The remote is not connected to a Nunchuk peripheral.
  • The remote’s batteries are at least half full.

Central Narrative: A Nintendo Wii console was hooked up to a break room TV at Site-23. Almost immediately after, a researcher suffered severe injuries when one of the console’s remotes was sent flying into the TV. A security officer ordered for the console to be removed and disposed of, but submitted the previously mentioned remote to the labs for research. Soon after this, the object was registered as an SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The Wii remote is mysterious in that there is very little potential for explaining its anomalous properties, and that it has potential use to the Foundation as a means of keeping peace at its sites.

Additional Notes: I wasn’t able to find any SCPs similar to this concept, so I was hoping critics could let me know if there are.

item.title: The Technician's Glasses
item.description: Anti-memetic glasses that explain the SCP universe's interaction with the law of conservation of mass
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: When worn, you are put in an anti-memetic state and, when viewing any anomaly that seemingly creates matter or energy, you will see a rubber wire leading out of it and into the sky.

Central Narrative: The foundation interacts with the 'electricity' that comes from these wires, until eventually they receive an invoice from the 'Electric Company' advising them to cease experimentation. They are successful in the creation of numerous useful anomalous devices before eventually, a 'Technician' appears in the site and retrieves the glasses before amnesticizing the foundation staff and deleting the file, which is found in data-backlogs by MTF-Rho 9. The item is considered neutralized for the time being.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The file is seemingly still anti-memetic and one needs to be conditioned using memetic images to view it. The underlying narrative of a foundation existing above the foundation responsible for the empowering of Anomalous items is the main hook of the article. Another piece of the puzzle is added to the mystery of where the energy for anomalies come from, with more room for expansion.

item.title: SCP IN NEED OF GREENLIGHT!!! LIFE GIVING PARASITE
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: The scp is a life giving parasite that infect inanimate objects and gives them vital organs and personalities. These instances usually become suicidal and begin to ponder on why they were given life. All instances that the foundation has encountered have been friendly and interactive. as If they were human. The foundation contains them by putting them in separate decompression tanks. They have monitors on the side that keep track of their vital signs. The foundation also keeps track of the lifespan of the infected instances. On one occasion, a parasite left the object. That object: (a toothbrush) was able to continue functioning as a regular tooth brush.

Central Narrative: It is a parasite that gives every day objects the ability to live.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The origin of the parasites are unknown. There are currently 110 encounters on the foundation record.

item.title: The false monster.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Emotional

Elevator Pitch: Ok, so the skip is a snake woman that is bad. But it's not really true that she's a monster, because she has been trolled by gamer against weed. Because of that, the foundation will try to kill it because when someone sees her, the person thinks she's some kind of devil.

So, a scientist is the only one that didn't see the SCP and will try to make research without having any information about the SCP.

item.title: The Perfectionist
item.description: A humanoid entity with a slight narcissistic attitude
item.content:encoded:
A humanoid entity with a slight narcissistic attitude paired with an ability to mess with minds. (Seeking critique, as this will be my first idea on the site)

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: This SCP is a humanoid entity with an unspecified or no gender, this SCP has its own anomalous property that make others 'listen' to it in a way. With its inhuman looks and narcissistic personality it caused a few problems…

Central Narrative: When a staff member found this SCP roaming the streets it was shouting at someone and then killed that someone while showing itself under the hood. Only to be caught detained shortly after by the staff member who was watching this unfold. It is now being held and contained, but makes trouble about being perfect and such often. Not much is known about the SCP, except for things like its ability to 'trick' the human mind, but it is thought to be from another place, planet, or possibly even universe, the Foundation cannot specify except the fact that it knows what it is, and possibly where it is from. Yet it will not comply or tell them either, as this was tried and failed.

+ show block
– hide block

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP can use its words to make people listen to it, it can somehow make people listen when it brings up something that a person wants, and tells them (The person) what to do to get it, making them do something that them in their right mind wouldn't, like going closer to said SCP. The effect that it gives needs to be tested on a bit more, as the Foundation doesn't know if it is explainable scientifically as of yet. The ability, or anomalous effect, the SCP has is connected to its nickname and personality, since it has slightly hinted at it, as those who are perfect do not have greed or something they want, this SCP may 'want' something but it does not think like that, it thinks that it can get it because it is perfect. And if the anomalous effect is connected, that means it has no sins or anything imperfect, from its point of view, maybe meaning if you do something that counts as bad or imperfect, also in its point of view, it may be able to get into your head.

Additional Notes: I'm not good at explaining ability's or anything of the sort, and this is my first ever SCP idea I'm putting here, so I would like good feedback on what I should change, or a different thing I should do.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.title: The Phone Book
item.description: A Phone Book containing the name and current location of every person who’s ever lived
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: the idea for this SCP is an old phone book which contains the name and current location of every person to have ever lived.

Central Narrative: the foundation acquires this object after tracking down and capturing a serial killer believed to have anomalous abilities. Upon interviewing the serial killer the foundation was made aware of a phone book, and that this was how he was able to kill people so cleanly. After this the foundation raided the mans home and acquired the SCP, and converted the serial killer to D-class.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think what makes this interesting is it kind of explains how the foundation can almost always find people, but it also shows the selfishness of the foundation. Because the book could be used to discover so many things, yet the foundation is keeping it to themselves.

Additional Notes: I’m aware I may be a bit vague, but this is really just an idea right now and needs some more fleshing out.

item.title: Tales of Archivist Tündér
item.description: Head of the digitization project for SCP 4001 Alexandria Eternal
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Tale

Genre: Drama/Emotional & History

Elevator Pitch: An expansion upon the lore of Alexandria Eternal, the staff working on the project, the character of Alexandria Eternal itself, and the exploration of the history of Alexandria Eternal as well as the limits and bounds of what can be contained within the shelves of Alexandria Eternal.

Central Narrative: The main focus on this tale will be Archivist Tündér's experiences, project logs, and experiments performed within or related to Alexandria Eternal.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Archivist's Tündér's excitement, expectations, and experiences on the first time they entered Alexandria Eternal.

Additional Notes: Later on I will expand on Archivist Tündér's lore by showing how she moved up from the digitization of old handwritten SCP articles to suggesting testing that had yet to be attempted on various SCPs she became aware of as part of the digitization project and how her successful or enlightening testing suggestions earned her security clearance level 4 and the position of digitization lead on the SCP 4001 team.
